statement.text: Let $Y$ be a rational homology 3-sphere equipped with an action of a cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose $W$ is a 4-manifold with boundary $Y$ over which the action of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ extends smoothly. (a) What constraints are there on the intersection form of $W$? (b) Does there exist an integer homology sphere $Y$ bounding a homology ball such that $Y$ admits a cyclic group action that does not extend over any definite manifold of either sign? (c) Develop methods for constraining the intersection form of $W$ that apply to indefinite, non-spin $W$.
